---
name: Tell me what you need
about: Say what you are trying to build or run, so I can build the right things
title: "Need: "
labels: need
---

**What are you trying to do?**
In your own words.

**Who is it for?**
For example: just me, my startup, my company, my clients.

**What would help most?**
A finished app, a building block for your own app, or something else.

**Anything else?**

Please do not include passwords, keys, or other people's private details.
